integration_requests.request: Add the twelve new public headers to On1xSDK.h and update CAPABILITY_MATRIX.json and IMPLEMENTATION_INVENTORY.json from this report.
Reconcile the local analysis status aliases 8..14 with the principal-owned common ABI-2 status header while preserving the exact ABI-v1 values 0..7.

Export/install a canonical compiler support target and make the installed static On1x::SDK transitively link it when analysis/pass objects are selected. The build-tree hook currently links on1x_frontend only through BUILD_INTERFACE because aggregate package ownership is principal-only.

When packaging a Novostone-enabled SDK, either export its exact Novostone/relational dependencies or compile the selector out of the installed SDK; do not leave an advertised adapter with unresolved static dependencies.
